svg.text: CONCEPT ARCHITECTURE v2 / JD-ALIGNED DESIGN / NOT YET IMPLEMENTED
One bounded workflow. Four complementary frameworks. Email only—not job-portal automation.
LANGGRAPH — THE ONLY OUTER WORKFLOW OWNER
Plan → execute → route • Durable checkpoints • Interrupt / resume • Bounded time, tools and retries
Validate request, facts and policy versions
Persist run state and stop conditions
Read sources, dates and professional contacts
Return evidence; never guess an email
Atlas history + prior Gmail Sent evidence
Retrieve approved facts with source IDs
Explain fit; do not invent reply odds
OpenAI Agents SDK: bounded Agent + Runner
Read-only MCP calls verify source evidence
Return claim report; no sending authority
Validate facts, schema, policy and consent
First unit: approve recipient + email + CV
Later: review-each or approved batch scope
Only the deterministic Gmail adapter sends
Check ledger, approval and remaining cap
Uncertain send: hold and reconcile first
Verify Sent evidence and archive exact CV
Sync failure: retry record, never resend
After first completed unit: choose mode
N reached, stop, budget cap or shortfall
Separate sent, complete, blocked and pending
next unit; ask mode once, never widen scope
Reject target → research (02); budgets still apply.
Uncertain send → pause; no blind retry or extra send.
REUSABLE SERVICES / CALLED BY THE NUMBERED WORKFLOW STEPS
Token / context caps; no paid fallback
Required real tool call in step 06
EXTERNAL I/O / SOURCE AUTHORITY AND EFFECTS STAY SEPARATE
Read 01: master CV and source versions
Immutable documents, not a lock database
Synthetic fixtures and mock mail first
No secrets or private CVs in public Git
ENGINEERING, SAFETY AND IMPROVEMENT / APPLY ACROSS THE WHOLE SYSTEM
Token, turn, retry, time and send caps
Enforced in code—not prompt text alone
Trace graph, model, tool and SDK calls
Usage, latency, cost and failure metrics
Adoption: observed runs, edits and reuse
Redact data; stop export at free-tier cap
No OpenAI trace export by default
RAG, grounding, safety and recovery checks
STUDY DEEPLY: orchestration, tools, RAG, MCP, approval, safety, evaluation and recovery.
Free-model design; hosted quotas and hardware costs still apply. Concept coverage is not implementation or interview mastery.
